title: EIP-8115: Batch priority fees at end of block
description: Delay all priority fee credits from transactions to end of block
author: Etan Kissling (@etan-status), Gajinder Singh (@g11tech)
laymanDescription: Every transaction pays a tip to whoever produces the block, and each tip is credited the moment that transaction finishes. The producer's balance therefore changes hundreds of times per block. This proposal adds the tips up and pays them once, after all of the block's transactions have run.
benefits: Removes a write to the fee recipient's balance from every transaction, aiding parallel execution
A sender can no longer become solvent only after earlier transactions in the block
One credit per block instead of hundreds of micropayments, simplifying accounting and transfer logs
tradeoffs: Fee recipients can only spend priority fees in the next block, not the current one
Block builder infrastructure and liquidity assumptions for MEV need updating
